data.name: Custom Scout Trip
data.headline: Meet animals and earn community service!
data.description:
Our Custom Girl Scout Trip is the perfect opportunity for all ages to learn about and interact with a variety of animals and build compassion through visiting different departments at the Center or fulfilling community service work. You can even purchase a custom Helen Woodward Animal Center patch to commemorate the visit!  Each program is 90 minutes long and allows each troop to choose the activities and animals included in the tour for the ultimate customizable experience!

* A minimum of 5 children is required to make this booking, however you may bring less children on the day of the program. You will not be refunded the difference if less than 5 children attend.

Customize the visit the way you want it!
* Option A: 4 animal visits and 1 Center activity.
* Option B: 2 animal visits and 2 Center activities.
data.itinerary:
* The program will begin with a brief introduction and set up rules and expectations.
* Rotate animals and locations about every 15 minutes depending on species. Typically we introduce the individual animal then talk about its species based on the focus of the selected theme, allowing for interaction and questions near the end of the presentation.
* Rotate activities and locations about 30 minutes depending on activity type.

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067

data.what_is_included:
You animal choices are as follows:
* Turtle or Tortoise: Learn about the differences in their habitats.
* Snake: Learn about their unique adaptations and snake safety.
* Sheep or Goat: Learn about their peculiar digestive system and farm animal care.
* Bird (dove, parrot, or chicken): Learn about animal classifications and life cycles.
* Miniature Horse: Learn about the “jobs” they perform, both past and present.
* Madagascar Hissing Cockroach: Learn about misconceptions of these creepy crawlies.
* Lizard: Learn about their classification and interesting defense and protection methods.
* Rabbit or Guinea Pig: Learn about proper pet care and Pet Encounter Therapy.
* Dog: Learn about canine body language and the importance of safety. These dogs are already owned by someone and are part of our animal ambassador team. Their use is based on owner availability.


Activity types are as follows:
* Equine Hospital: Go behind the scenes and see the different areas of the hospital.  Observe the steps a horse patient goes through during a surgery, and recovery. (Must be 7 years or older)
* Therapeutic Riding: Tour the barn, meet the program horses, and learn about the many benefits for disabled riders. (Must be 7 years or older)
* Community Involvement: Participate in a unique activity to help the animals at Helen Woodward Animal Center. Pick from one of the options below.

* Sheep feeding encounter: guests will hand feed our sheep Bermuda hay pellets, which not only provides the sheep with an exciting special treat, but also teaches the sheep to become more comfortable around new faces. Recommended for any group size.
* Small Mammal enrichment: create enrichment toys and food puzzles for our small mammals to enjoy! Recommended for groups of 4-10 people.
* Small mammal socialization: assist with the socialization of our small mammals by pairing groups of children up with a mammal and allowing the children to read to the animal. This helps our animals get accustomed to new sounds and smells! Recommended for groups of 4-10 people.
* Bird enrichment: create enrichment toys for our birds! Recommended for groups of 4-10 people.
* Write to Therapy Animals: Helen Woodward Animal Center’s Pet Encounter Therapy Program utilizes a team of volunteers and their amazing pets to bring unconditional love to those in need. In this activity, groups will write thank you notes to these special animals to show how much we appreciate them! Recommended for any group size.

data.cancellation_notes:
- We operate rain or shine.
- Canceling 31+ days prior: Will result in a refund of 75% of the paid value.
- Canceling within 30 days of your scheduled event: Will result in no refund.
- Rescheduling 31+ days prior: Will result in a fee of 30% of the paid value.
- We will allow your program to be rescheduled without a penalty for up to 3 business days once it has been booked. We are not able to reschedule within 30 days of your scheduled event and you will not receive a refund.
data.booking_notes:
#We are looking forward to seeing you!
#Check in Procedure
Meet at Education in the large covered pavilion. Plan to arrive 10 minutes before your program start time. Late arrival results in a shorter program with less time for animal interaction. Your instructor(s) will be waiting for you at the Education Department.
data.check_in_details: Our Instructor will be expecting your arrival, but may not immediately be out there to greet you if they are finishing room and animal preparation, especially if you arrive early. In that scenario you can come into the covered pavilion and can sit at our picnic tables and play in the pavilion space while waiting. Once the program is closer to start time, the Instructor will ask for your name to cross reference with a check list and then will shortly begin the program.
